dedupe_keys.name: two power flow techniques based on s iteration process sip nr msip nr

description: The power-flow algorithm authors publish MATLAB implementations of two S-iteration-based load-flow methods, SIP-NR and MSIP-NR. Zenodo lists twenty-five public files under CC BY 4.0, including solver routines, mismatch and Jacobian functions, and MATPOWER-style systems from small IEEE cases to several thousand buses. These files can benchmark convergence and voltage solutions before applying a solver in transmission or distribution simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this solver pair. Coverage is the supplied mathematical methods and benchmark cases, not a validated model of any live utility network. A limitation is that the own-page description does not give tolerance, scaling or convergence-failure statistics; the included test cases may differ from standard versions through limits. Users must check the expected MATLAB or MATPOWER environment. No script or system file was downloaded, and no residual or runtime was reproduced.
